articles.title: StakeDAO exploit creates 5.4 trillion vsdCRV but nets only $91K
articles.snippet: PeckShield said the attacker bridged 43.7 ETH to Ethereum after minting trillions of vsdCRV, while EmberCN said most of the remaining tokens had insufficient liquidity to sell.

articles.title: Three key XRP metrics suggest ‘explosive price expansion’ is next
articles.snippet: Falling MVRV ratio, high XRP Ledger activity and a bullish wedge pattern signal a potential XRP price rise toward $3.10.

articles.title: Ethereum bull David Hoffman explains why he sold his ETH
articles.snippet: “Ethereum got the ETH price it deserves, and I don’t see ETH being rerated as an asset, higher or lower,” says David Hoffman.
